title: QSP-TRIPLET-ER: quantitative systems pharmacology model and in silico trial of upfront versus second-line giredestrant and everolimus in advanced breast cancer
description: Code and input files of a hypothesis-generating quantitative systems pharmacology model and in silico trial that compares upfront treatment with a CDK4/6 inhibitor, giredestrant and everolimus with sequential therapy in ER-positive, HER2-negative advanced breast cancer. The model uses only published, aggregate data; verification/SOURCE_VERIFICATION.md lists every published input with its source. Running run_all.R in R 4.5 with a C++ compiler and the packages Rcpp, jsonlite, deSolve, rpart, survival, ggplot2, patchwork, ggrepel, ggtext, ragg, openxlsx and zip regenerates all results, figures and tables (about 7 hours on a laptop computer with a 6-core processor). Code for the article 'Quantitative systems pharmacology insights into upfront versus second-line giredestrant and everolimus in advanced breast cancer'.
